name: Ash Marble optional palette and material

accents.heroMetricRule: Only one primary KPI per section uses heroMetric by default; never encode good/bad status with decorative accents
accents.secondaryMetricRule: Use selectively when justified by information hierarchy or explicit metric identity, not on every KPI

dataColors.note: Series colors identify data, not status. Keep legends, labels, and non-color cues. Inherit existing semantic status tokens until independently validated.

marble.rendering: decorative pseudo-element behind content; pointer-events:none; never blend over type; nested controls and exact-value tables use opaque flat surfaces

themeCompatibility.darkPolicy: fall back to existing Sage dark tokens, disable marble unless a separately tested dark-material profile is added

typography.assetPolicy: Font names are stacks only; target applications must legally source and load font files themselves.
